source.title: Harquahala Sun (Copia Power) — project page: permitting and project description
source.nature: an applicant's own site: the decision numbers and county case numbers are citations to public records, the dollar figures are the applicant's estimates

claims.claim: What the site is and where its power goes
claims.quote: Harquahala Sun is a series of hybrid solar photovoltaic and battery storage power plants located in Harquahala Valley in west Maricopa county. Electricity generated by the power plants is transmitted via 500 kV transmission lines to the nearby Delaney substation, operated by Arizona Public Service (APS).
claims.kind: the applicant's description of its own project
claims.use: Names the destination: APS's Delaney substation. That is the hand-off point between a private build and the regulated network.
claims.verbatim: Harquahala Sun is a series of hybrid solar photovoltaic and battery storage power plants located in Harquahala Valley in west Maricopa county. Electricity generated by the power plants is transmitted via 500 kV transmission lines to the nearby Delaney substation, operated by Arizona Public Service (APS).

claims.quote: On June 21, 2022, the Arizona Corporation Commission approved the Project's Certificate of Environmental Compatibility (CEC) in Decision 78590. The CEC authorizes the construction of a collector substation and approximately 3.5 mile 500kV generation transmission which will connect the Project to the Delaney substation.
claims.kind: cites a Commission decision by number
claims.use: A permitted 500 kV connection, decided in 2022.
claims.verbatim: On June 21, 2022, the Arizona Corporation Commission approved the Project's Certificate of Environmental Compatibility (CEC) in Decision 78590. The CEC authorizes the construction of a collector substation and approximately 3.5 mile 500kV generation transmission which will connect the Project to the Delaney substation.

claims.quote: On January 25, 2023, the Arizona Corporation Commission approved the Project's Certificate of Environmental Compatibility (CEC) in Decision 78850. The CEC authorizes the construction of new 500 kV transmission lines with an approximate corridor length of 13 miles, together with associated 500 kV substations.
claims.kind: cites a Commission decision by number
claims.use: Thirteen miles of 500 kV corridor and substations, permitted in 2023.
claims.verbatim: On January 25, 2023, the Arizona Corporation Commission approved the Project's Certificate of Environmental Compatibility (CEC) in Decision 78850. The CEC authorizes the construction of new 500 kV transmission lines with an approximate corridor length of 13 miles, together with associated 500 kV substations.

claims.claim: Phase III, approved, and where it was heard
claims.quote: On August 13, 2024, the Arizona Corporation Commission approved the Project's Certificate of Environmental Compatibility (CEC) in Decision 79467. The CEC authorizes the construction of a new 500 kV transmission line approximately 19 miles long and a switchyard extending transmission lines previously approved in Docket L-21185A-22-0072-00201 and Docket L-21185A-22-0273-00211.
claims.kind: cites a Commission decision and two dockets by number
claims.use: Nineteen more miles and a switchyard, permitted in 2024, extending corridors approved in 2022 and 2023. Three decisions in three years on one company's corridor.
claims.verbatim: On August 13, 2024, the Arizona Corporation Commission approved the Project's Certificate of Environmental Compatibility (CEC) in Decision 79467. The CEC authorizes the construction of a new 500 kV transmission line approximately 19 miles long and a switchyard extending transmission lines previously approved in Docket L-21185A-22-0072-00201 and Docket L-21185A-22-0273-00211.

claims.claim: Phase III was heard in Goodyear
claims.quote: The Arizona Power Plant and Transmission Line Siting Committee held public hearings on June 17 and 18 at Hampton Inn & Suites - 2000 North Litchfield Rd, Goodyear, AZ 85395
claims.use: The public hearings for this corridor have been held in the West Valley towns the corridor runs through.
claims.verbatim: The Arizona Power Plant and Transmission Line Siting Committee held public hearings on June 17 and 18 at Hampton Inn & Suites - 2000 North Litchfield Rd, Goodyear, AZ 85395

claims.claim: Phase IV is the application in Case 248
claims.quote: Copia Power has submitted an application for a Certificate of Environmental Compatibility for a transmission line in Maricopa County to interconnect new generation, load, and increase resiliency. This new project will expand upon the first three phases.
claims.use: The applicant names its own parent, Copia Power, and states the purpose as interconnecting generation *and load* — the data-centre half of the transcript's argument, in the company's own words.
claims.verbatim: Copia Power has submitted an application for a Certificate of Environmental Compatibility for a transmission line in Maricopa County to interconnect new generation, load, and increase resiliency. This new project will expand upon the first three phases.

claims.quote: Maricopa County CPA Case # CPA250002 and ZC Case #Z250015 for the Harquahala Energy Generation and Industrial Campus
claims.use: The zoning half of the question, cited by case number at the county.
claims.verbatim: Maricopa County CPA Case # CPA250002 and ZC Case #Z250015 for the Harquahala Energy Generation and Industrial Campus

claims.claim: What the county applications ask for
claims.quote: Comprehensive Plan Amendment (CPA) application to change the designated land from Rural Density Area to Utilities on 13 parcels and a Zone Change (ZC) application to change the overlay from Rural-43 to IND-2 IUPD on 19 parcels were submitted on April 17, 2025.
claims.kind: the applicant's description of county filings
claims.use: Rural land becoming Utility and industrial land, on paper, with parcel counts and a submission date. This is the mechanism behind the land claim in this project, visible in a county case number.
claims.verbatim: Comprehensive Plan Amendment (CPA) application to change the designated land from Rural Density Area to Utilities on 13 parcels and a Zone Change (ZC) application to change the overlay from Rural-43 to IND-2 IUPD on 19 parcels were submitted on April 17, 2025.

claims.claim: The applicant's own estimate of what phase I brought
claims.quote: Total investment in Harquahala Sun project facilities, infrastructure, wages and services is estimated to total over $350 Million.
claims.kind: the applicant's estimate — a marketing claim, not a measurement
claims.use: Recorded as a claim by the party with an interest in it. The same page also estimates about $100 million in additional Maricopa County tax revenue over the project's lifetime.
claims.verbatim: Total investment in Harquahala Sun project facilities, infrastructure, wages and services is estimated to total over $350 Million.
